graduate_attributes.desc: Ability to critically analyze laboratory data, synthetic processes, pharmacokinetics, and clinical information.

graduate_attributes.title: Ethical and Professional Integrity
graduate_attributes.desc: Commitment to the Pharmacist’s Oath, ethical codes of conduct, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.

graduate_attributes.title: Patient-Centered Orientation

graduate_attributes.title: Innovation & Problem-Solving Mindset
graduate_attributes.desc: Capability to identify unmet needs and engineer practical, evidence-based pharmaceutical solutions.

graduate_attributes.title: Lifelong Learning Orientation
graduate_attributes.desc: Self-directed dedication to continuous professional development, advanced research, and clinical growth.

PO1.title: Pharmacy Knowledge
PO1.desc: Apply comprehensive knowledge of pharmaceutical sciences, biomedical sciences, pharmacology, pharmacognosy, chemistry, and manufacturing.

PO3.title: Pharmaceutical Skills & Practice
PO3.desc: Demonstrate proficiency in formulation, analytical QA, pharmacovigilance, and patient pharmacotherapy.

PO5.title: Research & Innovation
PO5.desc: Design and conduct basic research, analyze experimental data, and contribute to startup initiatives.

PO6.title: Professional Ethics & Human Values
PO6.desc: Apply ethical principles, regulatory frameworks, IPR, and universal human values in pharmacy practice.

PO7.title: Communication & Interpersonal Skills
PO7.desc: Communicate effectively through clear documentation, counseling, multidisciplinary teamwork, and presentations.

PO8.title: Leadership, Management & Entrepreneurship
PO8.desc: Demonstrate managerial competence in healthcare systems, quality systems, and startup ecosystems.

PO9.title: Pharmacist & Society
PO9.desc: Evaluate public health, safety, rational drug use, and community health outcomes responsibly.

PO10.title: Environment and Sustainability
PO10.desc: Promote green pharmacy principles, safe waste disposal, and alignment with UN Sustainable Development Goals.

PO11.title: Life-Long Learning & Professional Development
PO11.desc: Engage in self-directed continuous learning to adapt to rapid therapeutic and technological advancements.
